name: aspnet-core-scaffolding
title_zh: 新项目先立 Clean Architecture 骨
tagline_zh: 新建 ASP.NET Core 方案时，自动铺好 DDD 分层、CQRS 读写分离、Result 模式与验证管道。
tagline_en: Spin up a new ASP.NET Core app with DDD layering, CQRS (EF Core writes, Dapper reads), Result pattern, and.
desc_en: Scaffolds and evolves production-ready ASP.NET Core applications using Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, in-process IDispatcher, Result pattern, SQL Server, EF Core for writes, Dapper for reads, Domain-owned interfaces, Infrastructure implementations, FluentValidation, dependency injection, and Central Package Management. Use when creating a new ASP.NET Core solution, establishing it
why_zh: 把架构决策固化在脚手架里：写走 EF Core、读走 Dapper，接口归领域、实现归基础设施。
why_en: Hard-codes architecture decisions into the scaffold: write/read split, domain-owned interfaces, infra implementations.
limit_zh: 只认空目录或新解决方案；不处理已有业务代码的迁移。生成的骨架不含认证授权、日志、健康检查等横切关注点，需要自行接入。
limit_en: Only for empty dirs or new solutions; won't migrate existing code. No auth, logging, or health checks included—wire those yourself.
